verdict.rationale: Homebrew's project-scoped tooling is a per-repo Brewfile installed via `brew bundle install`, plus a manually invoked `brew bundle exec` shell environment. There is no evidence of automatic activation on entering a directory, per-project tool-version pinning, or project-specific environment variables. Community reports point the other way: users still rely on pyenv/nvm for multiple language versions and moved their dev environments to Mise. A manual shell is an adjacent feature and earns no credit toward automatic activation.
